_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Rank company jobs for profile

description:
Best for: which open jobs at up to 3 companies suit the user, such as "which jobs at Ramp fit a senior backend engineer with 7 years of Go?".
Returns: jobs ranked best first, each with a score, a fit of strong, possible or weak, a levelFit verdict (match, step_up, stretch, step_down), whyFit reasons, gaps and the applyUrl, plus one boards entry per company.
Input tips: send companies and targetTitles, such as {"companies": ["Ramp"], "targetTitles": ["Backend Engineer"]}. Add recentTitles, level, yearsExperience, skills, locations and openToRemote only when the user gave them; never guess.
Not for: listing every job at a company (use find_company_jobs) or the facts of one known job (use job_fit_brief).

companies.description: Company names or careers page links to rank jobs from, 1 to 3, such as ["Ramp", "Linear"].

level.description: Their current level, if known: one of intern, entry, mid, senior, lead, staff, principal, manager, director, executive. Otherwise it is read from recentTitles or yearsExperience.

limit.description: Most ranked jobs to return. Default 10, most 20: a larger value returns 20 with a note.

locations.description: Cities or countries they would work in, such as "London" or "DE". Up to 5.

openToRemote.description: true if remote roles are fine, false to avoid them. Leave out if no preference.

recentTitles.description: Titles of their most recent one or two roles; recruiters weigh these most.

skills.description: Key skills and tools, such as "Go" or "PostgreSQL". Up to 30.

targetTitles.description: Job titles the person is aiming for, 1 to 5, such as ["Backend Engineer"]. Ask the user if they gave none.

name: rank_jobs_for_profile

message.description: Set when status is not ok: for not_found ask for the careers page link, for unavailable retry once later.

title: Rank company jobs for profile
